subject: Follow-up: missed demo — flexible reschedule link
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick note — missed our scheduled demo

Hi Sarah —

We missed you on the call scheduled for today. No worries — I know schedules get tight. If you're still interested, here's a flexible link to pick a time that works in your calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/redwood-demo

A quick reminder of the agenda:
- 20 min walkthrough of Redwood Inference basics
- 10 min Q&A around integrations & security

If you'd like, reply with a couple of windows and I can book it manually. I can loop in Stephanie on the account side if there are procurement/security folks to include.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: demo-one-pager.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Cho <tom.cho@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick note — missed our scheduled demo

Hi Ben —

Sorry about that — was pulled into an exec review. I'm still interested. Our team is on PDT; best times for us this week are Wed 9-11am or Thu 2-4pm. If it's easier to send a few options, my colleague Tom (cc'd) can accept.

Can you also send any brief notes on data isolation and VPC options? I'll need to share that with security before booking.

Thanks,
Sarah
